correctness.rationale: Derived the published three-mass ODE exactly and checked it against original variables. The probability simplex is forward invariant, entropy decreases by two nonnegative flux dissipation terms, and vertex neighborhoods repel interior orbits, establishing global convergence. Exact centered coordinates give a stable sink with imbalance exponent λ and square-forcing exponent 2λ. Variation of constants gives the three asymptotic regimes with the resonance 2λ=β iff α=2/3. Above resonance the coefficient is allowed to vanish. 3,816 exact-rational algebraic checks, five transition identities, four independent ODE trajectories supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The three-opinion model is the smallest IPP system with a genuinely separate imbalance mode and moderate-opinion mode. Its full interior-parameter coexistence selection and the exact α=2/3 resonance answer a natural dynamical stability question left open by the source paper’s special-case analyses. The universal eventual undershoot of the middle-opinion share at and below resonance and the exact t prefactor at criticality give substantive, testable asymptotic distinctions not captured by the entropy principle alone.
